risk_notes.message: No uploaded CSV volume field; volume analytics must remain UNKNOWN.
DXY and DFII10 daily-only files cannot produce session/hour signals.
For instruments with reversal_after_3_same_direction_probability >= 0.55, require fresh catalyst before chasing the fourth day.
High seasonal win rates with n<10 are descriptive only and should not score strongly.

coding_notes: Use instrument symbol normalization before lookup; uploaded filenames include vendor prefixes and timeframe suffixes.
Never impute missing probabilities as 0. Missing means UNKNOWN.
Historical tendencies should adjust confidence and contradiction fields, not set direction.
Session overlap may be nested within New York depending on engine design; avoid double-counting session score.
Only activate a rule when sample size threshold and confidence are satisfied.
Correlation/sensitivity flags require synchronized cross-asset return analysis before activation.
Persist source_batch and source_file lineage for auditability.
